title: Discovered via TC-028 production release-check (Issue 28 follow-up): after saving a Price Estimator estimate and reloading it by its saved GUID (/price-estimator/:guid), the price table section (#pric
description: Discovered via TC-028 production release-check (Issue 28 follow-up): after saving a Price Estimator estimate and reloading it by its saved GUID (/price-estimator/:guid), the price table section (#priceTableSection) never becomes visible — the reloaded form does not repopulate rates/pricing data. The original Issue 28 fix only addressed empty property_pricing_details seed data; this full save-then-reload-by-guid path was not previously exercised against production.
notes: prefillFromSavedEstimate() re-injects the saved unit into allFlats/the flat dropdown when onBuildingChange() has filtered it out (status no longer available), before selecting it. No extra network call needed (unit data already in hand from the priceEstimation(guid) query). Verified locally (testing/unittests/ui/issue-31.test.js, 3 tests) and against production via TC-028, which now passes end to end (estimate save+reload, schedule save+reload, both DB-accuracy checks).
